m.e: I have my fair share of issues, but I'm working on it.

m.e: Fair warning though, it has a sad ending.

m.e: There's also been a fair share of bad luck.

m.t: Él trata a la gente de manera justa.

m.e: But I believed that my cause was righteous, too.

m.t: Y que nos dice la cantidad justa de la verdad para ocultar las mentiras.
m.e: And telling us just the right amount of truth to hide the lies.

m.e: It seems that you were made for the army.

m.e: Free will, I exercise that shit.

m.e: Because you massacred an army that was sent to protect us.

m.t: Y voy a destruirlo de una vez por todas.
m.e: And I'm gonna destroy it once and for all.

m.t: No pueden destruirlo si nuestro agente está allí.
m.e: Can not destroy it if our agent is there.

m.t: Si hubieras podido destruirlo, ya lo habrías hecho.
m.e: If you could have destroyed it, you would have done so already.

m.t: Encuentra una manera de destruirlo, o no tienes nada.
m.e: Find a way to destroy it, or you got nothing.

m.t: Padre, yo no volví para unirme a tu mundo, volví para destruirlo.
m.e: Father, I didn't return to join your world. I returned to destroy it.

m.t: Para destruirlo, tenemos que devolverlo a su origen.
m.e: To destroy it, we must return it to its source.

m.t: Teníamos un futuro hasta que empezaste a destruirlo.
m.e: We had a future until you started destroying it.

m.t: Es que... no quiero destruirlo hasta que sepamos que ocurrió.
m.e: I just... I don't want to destroy it until we know what happened.

m.t: Pero entonces, mientras estaba intentando destruirlo... me olvidaba de ganar.
m.e: But then, while I was trying to destroy him... I'd forget to win.

m.t: Cierto, de todos modos, tienes que destruirlo.
m.e: Right. Anyway, you need to destroy him.

m.t: Esto es demasiado importante para destruirlo ahora.
m.e: That is too important to destroy right now.

m.t: Y si lo encuentras, puedes destruirlo.
m.e: And if you find it, you can destroy it.

m.t: Entonces ya sabrá que tenemos que destruirlo.
m.e: Then you know we have to destroy it.

m.t: Encontrar el virus y destruirlo.
m.e: - Find the virus and destroy it.

m.t: Quizá deberíamos simplemente destruirlo.
m.e: Maybe we should just destroy it.

m.t: Los tres podemos destruirlo.
m.e: We three... we can destroy him.

m.t: ¿Para que puedas destruirlo?
m.e: So you can destroy it?

m.t: No quiero destruirlo todo.
m.e: I don't want to destroy all of it.

m.t: ¿Por qué no destruirlo?
m.e: Why not destroy it?

m.t: Negando que fuera anarquista, Katja mantuvo que solo quería hacer cambios en nuestro gobierno, no destruirlo.
m.e: Denying she was an anarchist, Katja maintained she wished only to make changes in our government, not to destroy it.
